name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking. Optional Telegram reports and commands, and automatic categorization of Amazon charges from their order emails.

release.notes: Reorganizes the addon into three tabs with a dashboard Overview, a self-completing setup checklist, and plainer wording. Adds a "Needs a category" tile that opens into the actual transactions, each dismissable with an undo window. The optional Telegram bot now answers seven commands — including /categorize, which files a transaction under a category from a tappable menu, and /newrule for plain-text categorization rules. Fixes Amazon's changed email format, which had silently stopped categorization, and surfaces unreadable mail as a visible warning instead of a server log line.
